group: Round 6 · Loot: item icons and pickup kit (loaded by the game)
title: Item icons: weapons 1 (common and rare)
use: Inventory, pickup cards and shop icons for the first 16 weapons of loot.js (training_sword to forge_sword, in that order).
prompt: A sheet of 16 game item icons in a grid of 4 columns by 4 rows, one item per 256-pixel cell, read left to right and top to bottom in exactly this order: 1. Camp Training Sword, a plain short bronze practice sword with a leather grip; 2. Bronze Dagger, a short leaf-shaped bronze dagger; 3. Camp Spear, a simple wooden spear with a bronze head; 4. Cyclops Club, a huge wooden table leg used as a club; 5. Bronze Hand Axe, a one-handed bronze axe with a wide blade; 6. Shepherd's Crook, a long wooden crook with a hooked top; 7. Celestial Bronze Xiphos, a leaf-bladed Greek short sword glowing faint gold; 8. Forge Hammer, a heavy smith's hammer with a glowing orange head; 9. Reed Staff of Pan, a green reed staff wrapped in vines with tiny floating music notes; 10. Electric Spear, a bronze spear with blue electricity crackling at the tip; 11. Labrys of Knossos, a great double-headed axe; 12. Spartan Kopis, a forward-curved single-edged sword; 13. Hoplite Dory, a very long spear with a leaf-shaped bronze head; 14. Empousa Fang, a curved white fang set in a bronze dagger hilt; 15. Ram's-Horn Mace, a heavy mace whose head is two curling ram's horns; 16. Forge-Fire Sword, a bronze sword with a red-hot glowing blade and small flames. Inventory icons in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: each item a small chunky 3D voxel model seen from a high three-quarter angle, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading and a small highlight, a bold silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels, celestial bronze that glows faintly, magic parts with a soft glow. Each icon is centred in its own square cell with even padding and never touches its neighbours; no frame, border, rarity colour, number or label in the cells (the game adds those). The whole sheet sits on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, texture or cast shadow, so the background can be removed. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
